target_text: the astonishing diversity of plant forms
notes: Degree intensifier (kin of remarkably) padding a diversity claim with no count or other magnitude in the essay to substitute.
Canonical Rule 5 adverb standing in for how much production rose; the essay gives no yield, tonnage, or percent figure.
Vague size intensifier (kin of extremely/significantly) in place of a count of drugs or compounds; listed examples are not a number.

target_text: a substantial portion of anthropogenic emissions
notes: Quantity intensifier standing in for a share of emissions. Nearby 120 Gt is annual uptake, not the emissions fraction, so there is no replacement fact.
Comparative degree adverb with no measured difference in response; cutting the whole phrase leaves a grammatical verb.
Degree adverb (kin of extremely) padding influence with no effect size, yield change, or other evidence.

target_text: the promise of botanical science is immense
notes: Predicative kin of extremely: empty magnitude with no supporting number. Dropping only immense breaks the clause; cut or rewrite the whole concessive pep.
Hyperbolic quantifier used as a number stand-in; the essay never states how many species are threatened or undescribed.
